title: Nordle content calendar
description: The plan for a brand: dated post ideas that Claude proposes, the owner approves, and Claude builds as the date gets close. Lives at <project>/calendar.json.

timezone.description: IANA name, e.g. Australia/Melbourne. Dates and times below are local to it.

campaigns.description: Named pushes with a goal and a window of dates (a launch, a sale, a awareness week). Posts belong to one by id; the posts can be made first and scheduled later.

message.description: The one thing the campaign says.

cta.description: What it asks people to do.

leadDays.description: Build an approved idea when its date is within this many days.

perMonth.description: How many of each format per month, e.g. {"reel":8,"carousel":3,"post":2}.

autoBuild.description: Off by default. When on, `nordle calendar run` builds due ideas without being asked.

autoPropose.description: Off by default. When on, `nordle calendar run` also proposes ideas to keep the next months filled.

autoRevise.description: On by default. When the owner presses Request changes in the Studio, the designer (a headless Claude run) starts on the change at once. Set false to leave sent-back posts for `nordle calendar run` or a Claude session.

regions.description: Which states' holidays, school terms and occasions apply. Empty or missing = national dates only in lint, everything in listings.

ideaApproval.description: 'delegated' = the owner has told Claude to go ahead before seeing the ideas: ideas Claude proposes arrive already approved. Only the owner can change this. Default owner.

compliance.description: Rule sets that apply to this brand's content, e.g. ["ahpra"] for Australian health advertising. Dental and other health brands are treated as regulated even when this is empty.

claudeModel.description: The model the Studio and the runner start Claude with (an alias such as sonnet or opus, or a full model name). Default sonnet: it builds a post well for much less.

claudeEffort.description: How hard Claude thinks while it builds. Default medium.

maxBudgetUsd.description: The most one run may spend, in US dollars (the run stops itself there). Default 2.50 for a build and 1.00 for new ideas.

maxBuildAttempts.description: How many times the runner tries to build one item before leaving it for the owner. Default 3.

review.description: The performance review loop (docs/PERFORMANCE.md). Without it no review is ever due.

cadence.description: How often the numbers are reviewed and the plan tuned.

weekday.description: Weekly only: the day of the week a review falls due, once every post in the week is 7 days old. Default monday. (Monthly reviews fall due on the 7th of the next month.)

autoReview.description: Off by default. When on, `nordle calendar run` also asks Claude to write a due review (the same safety rules as autoBuild).

share.description: Roughly how much of the month this pillar should fill.

idea.description: The idea in a sentence or two: what it says and why this audience cares.

hook.description: The first line or first second.

campaign.description: The id of the campaign this post belongs to (calendar.campaigns).

occasion.description: A date or season it rides on (Melbourne Cup, end of the health-fund year).

mediaPlan.description: What photos or footage it should use, in words.

pendingChanges.description: Changes the owner asked for while Claude was building this post: they wait here and are applied when the build is done.

queuedRevise.description: Set when waiting changes were just applied: the Studio starts the designer on this post, then clears it.

guidance.description: Extra information from the owner to steer this post: what to stress, who to feature, what to avoid, a reference to follow.

reel.description: Reels only: how it is made. style = auto (Claude decides), footage (cut from footage and photos), motion (motion graphics only) or voiceover (motion graphics timed to a voice-over); uses = what it uses; seconds = about how long.

status.description: idea = proposed by Claude; approved = owner said yes, build it; building; built = designed and waiting for the owner's sign-off; changes = owner asked for changes; signed-off = ready to schedule; scheduled = handed to a publishing adapter (see item.publish) for its time; rejected; posted.

publish.description: Set by the owner's publishing run (src/publish) when the post was scheduled: which adapter, when it is due (UTC, ISO 8601), the adapter's own id for it, and when it was handed over.

targets.description: One entry per channel the post was handed to (a brand can post to an Instagram account and several Facebook pages). The item is `scheduled` only when every channel the owner chose has ok: true; until then it keeps its status and this list shows what went and what failed.

origin.description: Who thought of it. 'buffer' = the post was made by hand in Buffer and Nordle copied it onto the calendar so it shows here (read only: Nordle never moves or deletes it in Buffer).

ideaApproval.description: 'delegated' = the owner told Claude to go ahead before seeing the ideas.

doc.description: The document built for it, once there is one.

external.description: A post made outside Nordle (an earlier pipeline). Copies of its files live inside the project so the Studio can show it.

feedback.description: What the owner asked to change on a built post (status changes). Claude fixes the post and the entries get a resolved time.

run.description: The runner's record for this item (src/calendar/run.mjs): how many build attempts, when, and the last problem.
